name: getrenderproperty
description: Returns the result of indexing the first argument with the given property key. For Drawing objects, this uses the same property lookup as direct object[property] access.

parameters.name: object
parameters.description: Value to index. With a Drawing object, the Drawing object's property lookup is used.

parameters.name: property
parameters.description: Property key used for indexing. Drawing object properties are string-based.
